context: Hello! How are you doing today?
I am doing well, thanks. How are you doing?
I am doing great, thank you for asking! I am here to help recommend a movie for you. What kind of movie and movie trailers do you like to watch?
I really enjoy comedies, nothing too cheesy though.
I feel that, sometimes cheesy movies feel like they're trying to hard to be funny. What's that last good movie that you watched? It can include a movie you watched at home or at the theater.
I watched Wine Country with Amy Poehler. That was pretty funny, but a little girly for my tastes.
Oooh, I haven't seen that one, I'll have to check it out! Are you interested in seeing a movie that's similar to Wine Country, or something different- perhaps less girly?
I'd prefer something less girly, so no rom coms.
Okay, got it! What's your favorite comedy movie?
Of all time? I really like Airplane, or anything with Leslie Neilsen.
That's an awesome movie, so many great one liner jokes. Leslie had such great comedic timing.
Yes, he's a classic. I think Will Ferrell is a lot like him. Both have that comedic presense.
Would you be interested in watching Anchorman?
I've seen that one, and it's great! I've probably watched it a dozen times. Anything like that would be great!
Okay, awesome! Have you seen The Campaign? That's another great and funny movie with Will Ferrell in it
I haven't seen that one! Who else is in it?
It also has Zach Galifianakis and Jason Sudeikis!
Oh that sounds hilarious! I'd love to check it out.
That's great! Would you be interested in checking out the trailer for it?
Definitely. I would love to check out the trailer.
I'm glad to hear that! I'm going to send the trailer your way, I hope you enjoy it!

context.content: Hi there! What kind of movies do you usually enjoy?
Hey! I'm into comedies mostly. Looking for something funny and maybe a bit quirky too.
Have you seen "My Favorite Year" (1982)? It's a charming comedy about a struggling actor who gets a chance to work with a famous director.
Sounds interesting! Can you tell me more about it?
It features great performances and a delightful story that captures the essence of the entertainment industry.
That sounds like my kind of movie. I love stories that are both funny and insightful. [END]
